描述_EN: bronze vessels and jade ritual objects of the early bronze age dynasties (about 1700 bc to ad 220) were particularly appreciated. they had a tremendous influence on the production of contemporary art objects, creating a style that modern art historians term 'archaism'. in the song period (960-1279) in china, collecting was an important cultural activity. this kettle, a pouring vessel for ritual use, is a later copy of an archaic bronze vessel.
描述_ZN: 青铜时代早期王朝（约公元前1700年至公元220年）的青铜器和玉石礼器特别受到赞赏。 他们对当代艺术物品的生产产生了巨大的影响，创造了一种现代艺术史学家称之为 "古代主义 "的风格。 在中国的宋代（960-1279），收藏是一项重要的文化活动。 这个水壶是用于祭祀的浇注器，是一个古老的青铜器的后期仿制品。
